yt_description:
Ever seen sorting algorithms do a back-and-forth tango? 🕺💃 Today, we dive deep into Cocktail Sort (also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort)! Watch as we visualize this clever algorithm that sorts from both ends, making it *almost* twice as efficient in some cases! 🤯


Get ready for:
✨ A clear, step-by-step visualization of Cocktail Sort in action.
💡 Understanding why it's called 'Cocktail' and its relation to Bubble Sort.
🚀 When to (and when NOT to) use this sorting method.
